about: Criteria for modules after v1. Each moves to its own catalog file when its module is built.

criteria.title: Prompt injection is detected, then blocked
criteria.statement: AI Guard flags prompt-injection attempts, and blocks them once the policy enforces.

criteria.title: Secrets and regulated PII are caught
criteria.statement: Secrets and regulated PII in prompts and replies are detected, or blocked when enforced.

criteria.title: Pilot users reach the POV app
criteria.statement: Pilot users open the POV application through the App Connector, with no VPN.

criteria.title: Everyone else is denied
criteria.statement: Users outside the pilot group can't reach the POV application.

criteria.title: Connector group is healthy
criteria.statement: The POV connector group has two healthy connectors for failover.

criteria.title: Pilot devices report a ZDX score
criteria.statement: Pilot devices report a ZDX score and the POV probes run.

criteria.title: SaaS posture findings appear
criteria.statement: A connected SaaS tenant shows posture findings.
